_doc: Standing decisions the operator has made about whole families of repos. modules/prior-ruling.js reads config/standing-laws.json (gitignored: it names private projects and their conventions) and reports a match as kind 'law' (a ruling for every project) or, with applies_to, kind 'constraint' (binds only those projects). Every law cites where it was made.

laws.law: example-org is the UI base on every front end (operator, YYYY-MM-DD)
laws.source: path or link to where the decision was recorded

per_project.project-a: a project-specific convention a reviewer must know

laws.law: project-b does not depend on some-vendor (operator directive)
